scope: One paired native self L2 qualification, not portfolio-wide lead time

protocol.selection: Unfiltered native full gate; no environment skip or threshold change; existing CI unchanged
protocol.cacheState: Existing warm installed dependencies/build on the same shared host; OS/Vitest caches and concurrent CI load not reset or controlled

environment.note: Node recorded by both native receipts; remaining host/toolchain observed after B, no toolchain changes in this experiment

comparison.coverage: Both PASS; required coverage and strict ratchet executed. Same 296 instrumented source files and 13030 total lines. Coverage lines A96.23%, B96.31%; no threshold change.

limitations: n=1 ordered pair on a shared non-idle host: not causal calibration, no confidence interval or sustained throughput guarantee.
Full-gate durations are sums of native step durations. Log file birth-to-final-write intervals are only an outer elapsed-time proxy, not independently instrumented wall time.
The passing native runner captures child output; no executed-test-count claim is derived from a static 1079-file selection list.
A and B reuse normal local caches without a reset; background runner load may differ.
A future final evidence-only HEAD requires fresh native exact-commit L2 qualification; that is not a second independent performance sample.
Seven pre-existing native not-applicable skips are identical in both runs; required coverage is not one of them.
Native raw receipts, logs and selection inventories are retained in the portfolio relay-live-20260908 evidence directory and addressed here by filename/hash.
